s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal autonomic nerve tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Similar immunohistochemical profile and histological features

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy and transmural, infiltrative proliferation

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation and histological features, including transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells

raw.rationale: The tumor's transmural, infiltrative growth pattern, uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, and strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 are consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, which is a type of sarcoma that arises from nerve sheaths.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal autonomic nerve tumor
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and less typical morphology

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Typically benign and less aggressive than the described tumor

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: Usually positive for CD117, DOG1, or CD34, which were all negative in this case

rejected.label: Clear cell sarcoma
rejected.why: Typically positive for HMB45, Melan A, or other melanocytic markers, which were negative in this case
